decisions.reason: Untitled web-snippet stub duplicating R002; only a 1956 secondary remark calling Wallman's 1858 case a 'colloid or paraphyseal cyst' (Glazer's label, anachronistic); no paraphysis or histogenesis content, so not necessary for any review dimension.

Wallmann 1858 autopsy report of the first third-ventricle colloid cyst; the paraphyseal concept dates from 1909, the record gives no origin argument, and the first-description date is citable via Glazer 1956; no bearing on paraphysis question.

Burckhardt 1894 on homologies of the diencephalic roof (epiphysis, paraphysis, dorsal sac) in lower vertebrates; needed for homology/terminology of the paraphysis versus dorsal sac (phylogeny, anatomy). Paraphysis is not named in the title and content is unverified (metadata only), hence B not A.

Dendy 1911 tuatara monograph on pineal organs 'and adjacent parts of the brain': by scope it must cover the roof between telencephalon and pineal complex (velum, dorsal sac, paraphysis of Sphenodon), key for reptile anatomy/ontogeny/phylogeny; no excerpt seen, content unverified - confirm paraphysis sections at full text.

Bailey(?) 1916 turtle telencephalic choroid-plexus morphogenesis: generic plexus title, authorship uncertain, only evidence is that it cites Warren's paraphysis work; cannot be shown to locate or homologise the paraphysis. Reinstate if the text relates the plexus to velum/paraphysis.

Warren 1917 on the pineal region in human embryos: Warren's 'pineal region' studies pair pineal and paraphysis, and human embryo staging of the paraphysis is a review gap (ontogeny); only title/metadata seen, content unverified - confirm paraphysis statement at full text.

1922 'Die epithelialen Gebilde am Gehirn der Wirbeltiere. I': no author, abstract or excerpt; title could cover plexuses, paraphysis or dorsal sac but nothing in the record ties it to the paraphysis. Contents of part I would resolve it.

Hines 1923 development of the Sphenodon telencephalon: ontogeny of telencephalon medium/lamina terminalis/roof, and one finder summary identifies the caudal midline outpocketing as the paraphysis (second summary silent); locates the reptile paraphysis in ontogeny. Content unverified.

Holmgren and van der Horst 1925 Ceratodus brain morphology: whole-brain title, no excerpt and no evidence of a paraphysis/dorsal-sac description; cannot be shown necessary. Full-text check of the roof section would reverse this.
Kappers, Huber and Crosby 1936 general comparative treatise, catalogue record only; no paraphysis passage identified and a general textbook is not rewarded for prestige (duplicate of R042).
Duplicate catalogue entry of the 1936 Kappers/Huber/Crosby treatise (R041); paraphysis chapter/page not identified, so it cannot be shown to bear on the review question.

Rudebeck 1945 forebrain morphology in Dipnoi: telencephalon-development title but no excerpt and no sign it treats the roof/paraphysis (coronarium/dorsal sac); insufficient to support inclusion. Full-text roof/velum section would reverse this.

Cairns and Mosberg 1951 clinico-pathological colloid cyst account: neutral title, no abstract (PubMed confirms none), no evidence it evaluates paraphyseal origin; excluded only for lack of text - reinstate (include_A, clinical_origin) if the discussion argues for/against paraphyseal origin.

Kelly 1951 analysis of 29 colloid cysts: neutral title, no abstract (PubMed confirms none), web check did not surface its stance on paraphyseal origin; excluded only for lack of text - reinstate if the full text evaluates paraphyseal origin.

Wislocki and Leduc 1952 vital staining/cytology of circumventricular organs incl. intercolumnar tubercle; the paraphysis link is only Kappers' later view, nothing in the record names the paraphysis; generic circumventricular paper.
Brizzee 1954 cat area postrema/supraoptic crest/intercolumnar tubercle cytology; generic circumventricular comparison with no stated paraphysis link in the record.

Legait and Legait 1956 innervation of third-ventricle ependymal organs in amphibians/reptiles: no abstract, and nothing shows the paraphysis is among the organs or is explicitly compared; cannot be shown necessary.
Testut-Latarjet Spanish general anatomy textbook, catalogue record only; no 'parafisis' passage retrieved, so it cannot be shown to bear on the review question.

Yenermen, Bowerman and Haymaker 1958 clinical study of 54 colloid cysts: clinical-series title, no abstract, nothing indicating a histogenesis or paraphyseal-origin analysis; excluded for lack of text.

Title field (catalogue-summary wording, not verbatim) names the paraphysis: vascular supply of epiphysis and paraphysis in reptiles; included on the title rule, CONTENT UNVERIFIED. Same chapter as R103 (Lierse, PBR 10); German 'Paraepiphyse' may instead denote the parapineal - verify and drop if so.

Same chapter as R099 (Lierse 1965, PBR 10:183-92, PMID 14281602); verified German-translated title says 'para-epiphysis' (MeSH pineal only), which may be parapineal, but R099 wording names the paraphysis; kept as a duplicate pair, CONTENT UNVERIFIED, merge records and verify chapter.
Nieuwenhuys 1965 Latimeria forebrain: PubMed shows no abstract, MeSH telencephalon/limbic system only; nothing indicates a paraphysis/roof description. Full-text check of the roof would reverse this.

Dempsey 1968 fine structure of rat intercolumnar tubercle; Kappers' paraphysis link is secondary and absent from this record (MeSH: pineal, pituitary, blood-brain barrier); generic circumventricular ultrastructure.
Giant-tortoise epithalamic hyperplasia case report; MeSH indicates pineal gland/choroid plexus only and no abstract mentions the paraphysis; a veterinary case report of off-topic structures.
Sarnat and Netsky general textbook on nervous-system evolution, catalogue record only; no statement about the paraphysis, cannot be shown necessary.

Meiniel et al. 1975 abstract explicitly reports the paraphysis (with dorsal telencephalon, tectum) as showing only constant weak non-specific 3H-5-HTP uptake in Lacerta embryos, in contrast to the epiphysis; minor/negative autoradiographic datum, but explicit original labelling data on the paraphysis (histochemistry, ontogeny).

Holbach and Gullotta 1977 abstract equates Rathke cysts with colloid cysts of the foramen of Monro and cites an ectopic upper-respiratory (endodermal) origin: an explicit histogenetic alternative needed to weigh the paraphyseal hypothesis (clinical origin). No paraphysis data and no original evidence, so limited weight.

Nieuwenhuys, Kremers and van Huijzen 1977 Latimeria gross brain survey: no abstract, MeSH only telencephalon/diencephalon; no evidence it describes the paraphysis or dorsal sac. Full-text check would reverse this.

Zanetti and Gordini 1977 autopsy colloid cyst whose title promises 'histogenetic considerations' (clinical origin); expected to weigh neuroepithelial/endodermal/paraphyseal origin, but no abstract so content unverified - confirm at full text.

Brocklehurst 1979 abstract: comparative CSF-system morphology (amphioxus to mouse) naming the paraphysis among compared ependymal derivatives with choroid plexuses and proposing a CSF chemical-environment function; paraphysis not principal and PMC full text is unreadable scans, so context for phylogeny/physiology, not A.
